metadata.question: Did Shanhai experience higher land surface temperature anomalies than Beijing during August 5-12, 2013 relative to the 2000-2012 average for that week?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need MODIS LST data (Terra/Aqua MOD11A1/MYD11A1 or MOD11A2/MYD11A2) - Baseline period: 2000-2012, August 5-12 for each year - Comparison period: August 5-12, 2013 - Locations: Shanghai and Beijing (need to define coordinates) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands - should mask poor quality pixels - This is about temperature, not clouds, so mask using QC flags 3. Logic: - Calculate baseline (2000-2012) average LST for Aug 5-12 - Calculate 2013 LST for Aug 5-12 - Compute anomaly = 2013 - baseline for both cities - Compare: Shanghai anomaly > Beijing anomaly? - Valid zero: If anomaly is 0 or negative, that's valid (cooler or same) - C3: If results are None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., >100K anomaly) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define city locations const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.4737, 31.2304]); const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]); // Function to get LST for a date range function getLST(startDate, endDate, geometry) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return null; } const meanImage = collection.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius const result = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count = collection.count().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); return { value: result.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(), count: count }; } // Calculate baseline (2000-2012) for Aug 5-12 let shanghaiBaseline = []; let beijingBaseline = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2012; year++) { const start = `${year}-08-05`; const end = `${year}-08-13`; const shResult = getLST(start, end, shanghai); const bjResult = getLST(start, end, beijing); if (shResult && shResult.value !== null) { shanghaiBaseline.push(shResult.value); } if (bjResult && bjResult.value !== null) { beijingBaseline.push(bjResult.value); } } if (shanghaiBaseline.length === 0 || beijingBaseline.length === 0) { console.log("Insufficient baseline data"); console.log("C1"); return; } const shBaselineMean = shanghaiBaseline.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / shanghaiBaseline.length; const bjBaselineMean = beijingBaseline.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / beijingBaseline.length; console.log(`Shanghai baseline (2000-2012): ${shBaselineMean.toFixed(2)}°C (n=${shanghaiBaseline.length})`); console.log(`Beijing baseline (2000-2012): ${bjBaselineMean.toFixed(2)}°C (n=${beijingBaseline.length})`); // Calculate 2013 values const sh2013 = getLST('2013-08-05', '2013-08-13', shanghai); const bj2013 = getLST('2013-08-05', '2013-08-13', beijing); if (!sh2013 || !bj2013) { console.log("No data for 2013 period"); console.log("C1"); return; } if (sh2013.value === null || bj2013.value === null) { console.log("Invalid 2013 values"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Shanghai 2013: ${sh2013.value.toFixed(2)}°C (count=${sh2013.count.toFixed(1)})`); console.log(`Beijing 2013: ${bj2013.value.toFixed(2)}°C (count=${bj2013.count.toFixed(1)})`); // Calculate anomalies const shAnomaly = sh2013.value - shBaselineMean; const bjAnomaly = bj2013.value - bjBaselineMean; console.log(`Shanghai anomaly: ${shAnomaly.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Beijing anomaly: ${bjAnomaly.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validation check if (isNaN(shAnomaly) || isNaN(bjAnomaly) || Math.abs(shAnomaly) > 50 || Math.abs(bjAnomaly) > 50) { console.log("Invalid anomaly values"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (shAnomaly > bjAnomaly) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
